lead: `??` binds tighter than `as`, so `$store->get($k) ?? "" as string` casts the *fallback* and leaves the whole expression `string|mixed`.
body: The obvious spelling for reading back a `mixed`-returning member is `string $back = $x->get($k) ?? "" as string;`, and it fails `E0401: expected string, found string|mixed` with the caret under the whole expression — which reads as though `??` had not removed the `mixed`, rather than as a precedence question. Write the coalesce in parentheses, `($x->get($k) ?? "") as string`, which is what every case reading a `mixed` back wants.
